headline: Unilever Nigeria Reports Earnings Growth Driven by Food Segment
summary: Unilever Nigeria released its 9M unaudited financial statements, showing that its food business powered profit growth and offset weaker sales in the Personal Care segment.
why: Unilever Nigeria is a prominent consumer goods company listed on the regional exchange, reflecting local purchasing power and segment-specific demand trends.

impacts.name: Unilever Nigeria
impacts.why: Food business revenue growth lifted overall earnings despite weakness in personal care.
